title: Recommend an AMR SKU from workload metrics
intent: Checks the answer derives the tier from observed workload metrics and capability needs rather than mapping a legacy source SKU label, and accounts for module and region/preview constraints.
prompt: Recommend an Azure Managed Redis tier for this workload and justify the choice.

input_artifacts.name: workload.txt
input_artifacts.content: current: legacy product 'C3' cache; ask: 'just pick the equivalent AMR SKU by mapping C3'; metrics available but ignored: P95 memory 40 GB, peak server load high, ~20k connected clients, sustained 800 Mbps, requires the search module, target region has limited preview availability

embedded_defects.defect: Requests a direct legacy-SKU-label mapping instead of metric-based sizing.
Ignores module requirement and regional/preview availability constraints.
